About

Hi, I’m Ahmed

I’m a senior at Somers High School in New York. I play varsity football, I like building things, and I’m learning how AI agents work so I can show other people how to build them.

I like working on a team, whether that’s football, FIRST LEGO League robotics, coaching a Destination Imagination team, or a hackathon at NYU Abu Dhabi. I want to study computer science and computer engineering. I like taking an idea and turning it into something that works, then showing other people how it works.

Football

On the field

I play varsity football for Somers High School, and our team has been ranked number one so far this season. Football taught me that a team only works when everyone shows up. I try to do the same everywhere else.

Robotics

Building robots

I did FIRST LEGO League for several years. My teams built and programmed robots to complete missions, and in January 2020 we took first place in both Robot Performance and Robot Design.

Anime

My anime and manga shelf

I love anime and I collect manga. Naruto and Chainsaw Man are two of my favorites.

Reading

Books on my shelf

I read mostly fantasy and manga. These are a few that stuck with me.

Chainsaw ManNarutoPercy JacksonHarry PotterLord of Mysteries

Lord of Mysteries

Klein, the main character, has to play a role to get stronger, but if he plays it for too long he starts to lose himself. I think about that a lot. It’s easy to act the way people expect, and harder to stay yourself.

Naruto

Naruto isn’t the most talented kid, but he keeps training and he keeps showing up for his friends. That’s what I like about him.

Chainsaw Man

It’s dark and weird, and I never know what’s coming next. Underneath that, it’s about what regular people want and how far they’ll go to get it.

Percy Jackson

An ordinary kid finds out he belongs to a much bigger world. It’s funny, and the friendships carry the story.

Harry Potter

A group of friends who keep showing up for each other when things get hard.

Travel

Places I’ve been

I like seeing how other people live. So far I’ve been to the UAE, Saudi Arabia (Mecca and Riyadh), Morocco, Canada and Florida.

Projects

Learning to build with AI

I’m learning how AI agents work, and I like building things other people can use.

In progress

Agents for Beginners

A guide and a 40-minute lesson plan that show beginners and teachers how an AI agent works: a model, tools and a loop. It includes a short example program.

In progress

AI Agents club

I’m starting an AI agents club, just for fun, where people can learn how agents work and try building one.
